children.text: A WordPress site with managed hosting, a security plugin, a page-builder license, and someone to keep it updated typically runs $150–440 a month — before you count your own time. Baseline is $97/mo, hosting included. For most businesses this is a step down in cost, not up.

Builder tools like Wix or Squarespace are cheaper on paper. But if your site is supposed to bring in work, speed and credibility matter — and a $12/mo builder site typically scores under 50 on PageSpeed. Slow sites lose leads you never even see.
